decisions.reason: As a small accessory closely tied to the core trailer business, it likely uses little slack and there is no clear sign of results below aspiration after only one year.
A box car trailer series is central to the firm's established capabilities and its home-page placement suggests satisfactory early expectations rather than a shortfall prompting search.
The car transporter trailer is a more niche offer, but it still fits the firm's know-how and service network, so without evidence of poor performance management would likely continue it.
The low-bed trailer series sits squarely within the firm's core market and its prominent website visibility is consistent with keeping it while results are still being learned.

The high trailer cover series is adjacent to the established product range and likely not very resource-intensive, so an established medium-sized firm would usually retain it absent a clear aspiration shortfall.

Although another box car trailer series could face internal overlap, it remains a core line extension and there is no strong indication that management would reallocate resources away from it so soon.
